content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Organisational units Central Administrative Departments Student Services Student Services The Student Services Department will assist you with any questions you may have about your studies — the easiest way to contact them is via the contact form. Please feel free to include your pronoun in your enquiry if you would like to be addressed in a specific way.
